name: Grasping Vines
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

Thick, thorny vines erupt from the ground in a 5-ft square within short range. Roll Spirit vs. Dexterity against each creature in that space. On a win, the creature is grappled. On a loss, the creature moves to an adjacent space. Either way, your roll result becomes this spell’s Difficulty.

On each of its turns, a creature grappled by the vines may roll Strength against the Difficulty to attempt to escape. On a failure, it takes 1d6+HEART damage and the Difficulty increases by 2. On a pass, it escapes the vines, moving to an adjacent space, and the Difficulty decreases by 2.

The vines persist for the duration of your concentration, even if no creature is currently grappled. While the vines remain:

  • Any creature that enters their space must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty or become grappled.

  • A creature adjacent to the vines may spend an action to hack at them, reducing the Difficulty by 2.

When the spell ends, the vines wither into mundane growth but remain as difficult terrain. A creature that falls prone into the vines takes 1d6 damage from the thorns.

Describe the vines.

improvements.name: Wall of Vines
improvements.description: When you cast this spell, you may spend additional MP. For each additional 1 MP you spend, vines erupt in two additional 5-ft squares within short range. The squares must be contiguous.
